answer: A sybil defense binds identity value to a verifiable work chain. Each agent mints a keypair and burns compute to earn a genesis seal; that seal is a jade anchor for all future activity. Every epoch the agent extends the chain with a new proof, and peers witness each link, threading the seal forward. A reputation vault accumulates only for unbroken chains forged records are rejected. Cloning N identities demands N complete chains, each with its own marble of sustained work. Attacker cost scales linearly with count, while influence does not; farms stall before they can vote.
